comment: The internal clock adds the external clock jack's voltage to the tempo (Clause.cpp:148), but that branch only runs while the jack is unpatched, so the addition is always zero. A clock-passthrough flag exists that would make the clock output follow an external clock's own gate, but nothing on the panel or in the menu sets it; it is false on a new module and turns true only when a saved patch lacks the key (Clause.cpp:249-254).
